artifacts.summary: Implementation summary: selector conservativity argued and pinned, window drift closed by delegating target_window() to _box_window; full bimodal suite and four-theory gate green.

completion_data.completion_summary: Closed both A2 encoder-versus-specification gaps: WitnessRegistry.target_window() now delegates to certificate._box_window (no more independent definition), and the one-hot target selector's conservativity is argued in ADEQUACY.md section 7.3 and pinned by a new TestSelectorConservativity unit test against the re-checker's _target_holds. Full bimodal suite (441 passed) and the four-theory gate (parallel: 2944 passed/1 skipped; serial: 9 passed/3074 deselected) are green; no behavioral change.

reflection.what_worked: Confirming the window-position order (t increasing maps monotonically onto wrap-index increasing) let the selector-conservativity test's label-pattern generators be written once, length-parametrized, and reused unchanged across both segment-length configurations, instead of hand-writing separate fixtures per config.
reflection.what_was_hard: Three sibling tasks (192, 193) were dispatched concurrently on the same shared working tree and repeatedly touched files this task also reads (certificate.py, ADEQUACY.md, TRUST_PIPELINE.md, test_certificate_a2_triangle.py); staying disciplined about re-reading before each edit and staging only this task's own hunks (never a directory add) required care at every phase boundary.
reflection.what_was_missed: Nothing within this task's scope; the plan's own non-goals (widening the A2 grid to nb=nf=2) were correctly left to the sibling task already covering them.
reflection.successes: All five phases closed cleanly and independently committed; the full bimodal suite (441 passed) and both four-theory-gate passes (2944 passed/1 skipped parallel, 9 passed/3074 deselected serial) are green with no behavioral change, matching the task's explicit no-behavioral-change requirement.
